item.title: D4vd Murder Case: A Timeline of the Investigation & Charges Over Celeste Rivas Hernandez’s Death
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we break down the latest news and updates. Today, we're discussing the shocking case of 21-year-old pop singer D4vd, who's facing first-degree murder charges.
[Music transitions to a more somber tone]
Host: D4vd, whose real name is David Anthony Burke, rose to fame with his 2022 hit "Romantic Homicide". However, his career has taken a drastic turn with the allegations of murder and dismemberment of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez. Prosecutors claim that D4vd was involved in an illegal sexual relationship with the teenager and killed her when she threatened to expose him.
[Pause for emphasis]
Host: The alleged murder occurred on April 23, 2025, just two days before the release of D4vd's debut album, Withered. Months later, police found Rivas' decomposed and dismembered body in a Tesla registered to D4vd.
[Music continues in the background]
Host: D4vd has pleaded not guilty to all charges, and his attorneys claim they will vigorously defend him in court. They argue that the evidence will show D4vd's innocence and that he was not responsible for Rivas' death.
[Music transitions to a more neutral tone]
Host: The case has already had significant consequences for D4vd's career. His tour was cut short, and he was dropped by his record label, music publisher, and management team. We'll continue to follow this case and provide updates as it moves forward.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. For more information on D4vd's music career, check out our separate story. Thank you for tuning in, and we'll be back with more news and updates soon.
